---
title: "Why does a classical field require coherence?"
description: "Because a definite amplitude and phase is only possible in a superposition of many photon numbers."
categories: [fields]
order: 30
date: 2026-08-12
draft: true
---

::: {.oneline}
A state with sharp photon number has completely undefined phase. A field behaves classically only when it has a well-defined phase, which forces a broad superposition of number states — a coherent state.
:::

## Short answer

*To write.* A state with sharp photon number has completely undefined phase. A field behaves classically only when it has a well-defined phase, which forces a broad superposition of number states — a coherent state.
